reviews.review:
Surprising pretty awesome =D 
I didn't buy this game b4 because I read many bad reviews and I thought it was a mediocre game but guess what?
 Isn't , I highly recommend if you love the classic & legendary L4D and want to play some new gen game of zombies, I'm enjoying playing more Back 4 Blood than World War Z.
It has a deck building system which is pretty cool, you can customize weapons and clothes there is so many skins and outfits, '_' also 7 categories of weapons pistols, smgs, shotguns, ars, lmgs, sniper sifles and melee such as wolverine claws ;) with over 30 weapons + 9 legendary ones. 

I highly recommend this game my friends.
Back 4 Blood 10/10
Heisen
Never played that much, but doesn't seem as bad as some people say. Shooting feels very crisp and responsive.
very fun and best to play a friend group

PRO:
-really fun with friends
-turn off your brain kind of game
-many builds you can experiment with

CON:
-only buy it if it's on sale, it's not worth $60
-miserable single player experiences
-difficulty is VERY RNG based

Comments:
-play quick play, it's more fun with people 
-people are either 100+ hours or new to the game
-it's not left 4 dead 2, just another zombie shooting game
-depend on the difficulty, you can only allow to run certain meta decks
-add "Down to front" card to your deck to avoid friendly fire, very crucial

yeah it was really fun when it first came out, but the developers took too long for updates. Don't buy the game or any DLCs unless it's on sale, they don't care anymore. Although it's a really fun game, that's why I played 200+ hours. But I don't recommend you buying this game because it's not worth the price and it's not as fun unless you have friends or a party.

now if you have the money/x-box pass, it's definitely a game you should try out. This is one of those stress reliever game where you turn off your brain and shoot some zombies.

It was fun for sum hours with friends. Then its gettin boring cuz no new enemies, same locations etc...
